case_title: Policy is stuck in a local minimum at the centre

diagnoses.cause: Wout entries above the schema maximum 2: a spurious connection dominates its action wherever its hidden unit fires.

ground_truth_cause: One spurious Wout weight (centre fallback-UP, 1 -> 11) makes UP dominate at the centre whatever the goal is, so paths through the centre with a southern goal oscillate centre -> north -> centre and loop.
scope: TOY ONLY: 3x3 grid MLP, 20,612 parameters. Not a claim about any larger model.
